_note: Playstyle for the Ember Knight: a Pyre Strike deck with no Drills, one Ally and one Seal, where almost every card pays Fervor. It blocks far more readily than Ashmark does (a low play.defend_card), because a block here is a rung on the climb rather than a pause, and the Aspect 4 and 5 Powers are the payoff. Value defense cards and Fervor highly, value the Ascension win highly, and treat the Life Deck as a resource the Mastery and the discard-draws feed on.
name: pyre_ascent
